text: Given the normal CA-125 and postmenopausal bleeding, I need to evaluate the endometrium to rule out cancer. REQUEST TEST: Transvaginal_Ultrasound.

text: RESULTS: Thickened endometrial stripe and left adnexal mass observed

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound findings of a thickened endometrial stripe and an adnexal mass in the context of postmenopausal bleeding are highly suspicious for endometrial carcinoma with possible ovarian involvement. I will now request a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Endometrial_Biopsy.
